questions.question: What is Lamentations 5?
options: A long list of all the families who returned home from the exile
A long record of all of the kings who once ruled over Judah
A closing prayer asking God to remember and restore his people
A joyful song celebrating the great rebuilding of the city
questions.answer: A closing prayer asking God to remember and restore his people

questions.question: What does the poet ask God to do at the end of the book?
options: Hide away his face from them entirely and forever
Repay them fully according to all of their many sins
Scatter them abroad among all of the distant nations
Restore them to himself, that they may be restored
questions.answer: Restore them to himself, that they may be restored

questions.question: Lamentations 5 affirms that the LORD reigns forever, his throne enduring to all generations.
Remember, O LORD, what has befallen us; look, and see our _____.
_____ us to yourself, O LORD, that we may be restored! Renew our days as of old.
